en: Praise of the Perfection of Wisdom. Om, homage to the glorious Prajñāpāramitā!
To her who is free from conceptual construction, without support, blameless, and stainless.
O Goddess, who art eternal and imperishable, changeless, and possessed of wisdom; salutations be unto you! || 1 ||
O Sovereign Mother of the Buddhas, Grandmother of the Bodhisattvas, Great-Grandmother of all sentient beings—O Goddess Prajñā, homage be to you! (2)
O Mother, O Mother, O Mother of the World—to you who grant the heart’s desires, who are pure and wise, O Goddess, let there be salutation! (3)
O auspicious one, you are Lakṣmī; you are Śrī, Dhī, Śraddhā, Dhṛti, and Smṛti.
O Goddess, who are the embodiment of all, the sovereign of all, and supreme wisdom—salutations be unto you.
O Goddess Prajñā, who consists of the ten forms of the perfections, both supramundane and mundane, and who is immeasurable—homage be to you! (5)
The Praise of the Glorious Perfection of Wisdom is complete.
